instructions: Monorepo with feature/* → staging → main. CI runs four required checks; Build must not report success after an upstream failure. Reviews and deployment evidence must match the current source SHA. Digests-only releases. Conventional commits. Flag layer-boundary and secret leaks. Prefer AGENTS.md and docs/governance/ / docs/operations/ over guesses.

rules.rule: Flag changes that would fail test:architecture or violate documented domain ownership boundaries in AGENTS.md / code-structure skill / docs/governance/invariants.json.
Flag release/deploy changes that introduce mutable image tags (:latest, unpinned branches) instead of registry@sha256 digests. Align with packages/deployment and docs/operations/deployment.md.
Do not raise deployment-capability-register implementationState without matching evidence arrays. Do not weaken capability or artifact gates to force green CI.
Flag merge or release claims whose approval, required checks, manifest source revision, or review evidence does not apply to the current head SHA.

Flag deployment or rollback success that does not cross the configured adapter, validate an immutable release artifact, and persist structured durable evidence before acknowledgement. Simulation must never emit a successful terminal state.

Product repositories must classify every invariant profile as enforced with real tests or not-applicable with an owner and rationale; unresolved scaffold placeholders and generic ownership are blockers.

On new or changed exported functions, classes, types, interfaces, and function-like consts in the PR diff, require a short non-empty TSDoc/JSDoc block that states intent, invariants, ownership, or safety — not a restatement of the name. Align with AGENTS.md and npm run test:touched-tsdoc.
Do not hand-edit content between facts:start and facts:end markers. Change the authority in package.json (or authority-map.json), then run docs:facts:generate.
Continuity drill issues and ops docs must not contain passwords, tokens, private key material, or .env contents.
PR titles and commits should use conventional commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, test:, chore:) with optional scope.
